C036.name: Morogoro Municipal Council
C036.documented: repeated floods on the Ngerengere and Morogoro rivers, landslides on the Uluguru slopes, and heavy rain

area.en: Morogoro Municipal: Uluguru foothills and the Morogoro river
area.sw: Manispaa ya Morogoro: vilima vya Uluguru na mto Morogoro

risk.en: This area lies at the foot of the Uluguru mountains, where storms send flash floods and debris down the Morogoro and Kikundi rivers into low streets and riverside settlements.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko chini ya milima ya Uluguru, ambapo dhoruba hupeleka mafuriko ya ghafla na mawe kwenye mito Morogoro na Kikundi hadi mitaa ya chini na makazi ya kando ya mito.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build back from river banks, keep drains and culverts clear and keep goods above the highest known flood mark. What raises the risk: building new houses or stores inside the Morogoro and Kikundi river reserves, cutting plots into the Uluguru foothills and tipping waste into the channels. Know the higher ground away from the river that you will move to, and go when heavy rain is reported on the Ulugurus above the town, before the river reaches the road; do not try to cross flowing water. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za mito, kuweka mitaro na makalavati wazi na kuhifadhi bidhaa juu ya alama ya juu ya mafuriko inayojulikana. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba au maduka mapya ndani ya hifadhi za mito Morogoro na Kikundi, kuchonga viwanja kwenye vilima vya Uluguru na kutupa taka kwenye mikondo. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto utakalohamia, na ondoka mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa Uluguru juu ya mji, kabla mto haujafika barabarani; usijaribu kuvuka maji yanayotiririka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C038.name: Ifakara Town Council
C038.documented: Kilombero and Lumemo floods (embankment failures at Ipangalala), heavy rain, and cholera

area.sw: Mji wa Ifakara: tambarare ya mafuriko ya Kilombero

risk.en: This area is a town on the Kilombero flood plain, where the river spreads over low streets and fields in wet years and malaria and cholera rise after floods.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji ulio kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Kilombero, ambapo mto hutanuka kwenye mitaa ya chini na mashamba katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na malaria na kipindupindu huongezeka baada ya mafuriko.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build on raised plinths, keep drains open, sleep under treated nets and treat drinking water. What raises the risk: extending the town onto the lowest parts of the flood plain, blocking drains with waste, drawing water from flooded wells and hiding cases of diarrhoea. Know the higher street or school ground that is your assembly point, move there with children and the elderly when the Kilombero spreads towards the town, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga kwenye misingi iliyoinuliwa, kuweka mitaro wazi, kulala ndani ya vyandarua vyenye dawa na kutibu maji ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kupanua mji hadi sehemu za chini kabisa za tambarare ya mafuriko, kuziba mitaro kwa taka, kuchota maji kwenye visima vilivyofurika na kuficha wagonjwa wa kuharisha. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule ambao ni kituo chenu cha kukusanyika, hamieni huko na watoto na wazee Kilombero inapotapakaa kuelekea mjini, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C042.name: Gairo District Council
C042.documented: Mkondoa and Kidete floods, drought between seasons, and strong winds

area.en: Gairo: dry hills and the highway corridor
area.sw: Gairo: milima kame na ukanda wa barabara kuu

risk.en: This area is dry, eroded hill country on the Dar–Dodoma highway, where drought damages crops and storms send flash floods down gullies onto the road and town.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nchi ya milima kame iliyomomonyoka kando ya barabara kuu ya Dar–Dodoma, ambapo ukame huharibu mazao na dhoruba hupeleka mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye makorongo hadi barabarani na mjini.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees and contour bunds on slopes, build away from gullies and plant drought-tolerant crops. What raises the risk and to the loss when the rains fail: building at the gully mouths along the highway, clearing the last trees from the hills and relying on maize alone. Know the firm ground away from the gullies that your household will move to when a storm breaks on the hills, keep off the road where it crosses the gullies, and agree early where food and water will come from in a failed season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti na matuta ya kontua kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na makorongo na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara mvua zikikosekana: kujenga kwenye midomo ya makorongo kando ya barabara kuu, kukata miti ya mwisho milimani na kutegemea mahindi pekee. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia dhoruba inapoanza milimani, kaeni mbali na barabara inapovuka makorongo, na kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C037.name: Kilombero District Council
C037.documented: Kilombero valley floods, heavy rain, and cholera after the river rises

area.en: Kilombero: valley rice farms and Udzungwa edge
area.sw: Kilombero: mashamba ya mpunga ya bonde na pembezoni mwa Udzungwa

risk.en: This area covers the Kilombero valley, where rivers from the Udzungwa flood rice and sugar farms and cut roads, and wildlife from the park raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha bonde la Kilombero, ambapo mito kutoka Udzungwa hufurika mashamba ya mpunga na miwa na kukata barabara, na wanyamapori kutoka hifadhi huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes and stores on higher ground, use the flood plain seasonally and use community deterrents against wildlife. What raises the risk: building permanent houses and stores on the flood plain, blocking the natural outflow with bunds and roads, and farming right up to the park boundary. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the rivers from the Udzungwa rise, and move people, stores and animals there before the water reaches the fields. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala sehemu za miinuko, kutumia tambarare kwa msimu na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko, kuziba njia ya asili ya maji kwa matuta na barabara, na kulima hadi mpakani mwa hifadhi. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia mito kutoka Udzungwa inapojaa, na hamisheni watu, akiba na mifugo huko kabla maji hayajafika mashambani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C034.name: Kilosa District Council
C034.documented: Mkondoa floods at Dumila and the valley, heavy rain, and drought on the uplands

area.en: Kilosa: Mkondoa river and the railway corridor
area.sw: Kilosa: mto Mkondoa na ukanda wa reli

risk.en: This area has the Mkondoa river, which floods Kilosa town, farms and the Central Line railway in heavy rains, and dry plains where farmer–herder conflict occurs.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mto Mkondoa unaofurika mji wa Kilosa, mashamba na reli ya kati wakati wa mvua kubwa, na tambarare kame ambapo migogoro ya wakulima na wafugaji hutokea.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build above known flood marks, keep off the railway during floods and follow agreed land-use plans and livestock routes. What raises the risk: building new houses below the known flood marks of the Mkondoa, blocking its channel with plots and waste, and driving herds onto cropped fields. Know the high ground away from the Mkondoa that your household will move to, and go when heavy rain is reported upstream, before the river reaches the town; settle grazing and water arrangements between farmers and herders before the dry months. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya alama za mafuriko zinazojulikana, kukaa mbali na reli wakati wa mafuriko na kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi na njia za mifugo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba mpya chini ya alama za mafuriko zinazojulikana za Mkondoa, kuziba mkondo wake kwa viwanja na taka, na kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na Mkondoa ambalo kaya yako itahamia, na ondoka mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa juu ya mto, kabla mto haujafika mjini; kubalianeni, wakulima na wafugaji, kuhusu malisho na maji kabla ya miezi ya kiangazi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C040.name: Malinyi District Council
C040.documented: Kilombero floods, heavy rain, and strong winds with hail

area.sw: Malinyi: ardhioevu ya mbali ya Kilombero

risk.en: This area is remote wetland and flood plain where villages are cut off for weeks in the rains and help can take a long time to arrive.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni ardhioevu ya mbali na tambarare ya mafuriko ambapo vijiji hutengwa kwa wiki kadhaa wakati wa mvua na msaada unaweza kuchukua muda mrefu kufika.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build on raised ground, keep food, water and medicine reserves before the rains and travel by water only in safe conditions. What raises the risk: settling on the lowest ground of the wetland, letting household reserves run out before the rains, and crossing swollen channels in loaded canoes. Know the raised ground your village will move to when the water spreads and the household that holds the radio or phone for calling help; move stores, medicine and animals there before the roads close, because help may take weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu zilizoinuka, kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa kabla ya mvua na kusafiri majini katika hali salama tu. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukaa kwenye ardhi ya chini kabisa ya ardhioevu, kuacha akiba za kaya ziishe kabla ya mvua, na kuvuka mikondo iliyojaa kwa mitumbwi iliyojaa. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia maji yanapotapakaa na kaya inayoshikilia redio au simu ya kuita msaada; hamisheni akiba, dawa na mifugo huko kabla barabara hazijafungwa, kwa sababu msaada unaweza kuchukua wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C035.name: Morogoro District Council
C035.documented: Ngerengere floods, Uluguru landslides, and heavy rain

area.sw: Morogoro DC: vijiji vya milima ya Uluguru

risk.en: This area has steep, densely farmed Uluguru slopes where heavy rain triggers landslides and erosion, and rivers flood the lowlands below.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali ya Uluguru yenye kilimo kingi ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko na mmomonyoko, na mito hufurika tambarare za chini.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes, protect springs and build away from steep cuts and stream banks. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house and clearing the forest above the villages; for rebuilding after a slide choose ground off that slope, and for houses still on it agree the way out and watch the cracks. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open, springs turn muddy or the rain has not stopped for a day; do not wait for the ground to move. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko, kulinda chemchemi na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba na kukata msitu juu ya vijiji; kwa kujenga upya baada ya maporomoko chagueni ardhi nje ya mteremko huo, na kwa nyumba zilizo bado juu yake kubalianeni njia ya kutokea na fuatilieni nyufa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka, chemchemi zikitoa matope au mvua ikiwa haijakoma kwa siku nzima; msisubiri ardhi ianze kusogea. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C041.name: Mvomero District Council
C041.documented: floods on the Diwale and Wami, landslides on the Nguru slopes, and heavy rain

area.en: Mvomero: Wami lowlands and mountain slopes
area.sw: Mvomero: tambarare za Wami na miteremko ya milima

risk.en: This area combines mountain slopes prone to landslides with Wami river lowlands where floods hit farms and sugar estates and farmer–herder conflicts occur.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya miteremko ya milima inayokumbwa na maporomoko na tambarare za mto Wami ambapo mafuriko hupiga mashamba na mashamba ya miwa na migogoro ya wakulima na wafugaji hutokea.

advice.en: For those living, farming and herding here, it helps to keep slopes planted, keep homes off flood plains and follow village land-use plans and livestock routes. What raises the risk: cutting into the mountain slopes behind houses, building on the Wami flood plain and driving herds onto cropped fields. On the slopes, agree with neighbours on a safe place and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy; in the lowlands, know the higher ground you will move to when the Wami rises, and settle grazing and water arrangements between farmers and herders before the dry months. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga nje ya tambarare za mafuriko na kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi na njia za mifugo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba miteremko ya milima nyuma ya nyumba, kujenga kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Wami na kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao. Miteremkoni, kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji yakitiririka ya matope; tambarareni, fahamu eneo la juu utakalohamia Wami inapojaa, na kubalianeni, wakulima na wafugaji, kuhusu malisho na maji kabla ya miezi ya kiangazi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C039.name: Ulanga District Council
C039.documented: Kilombero floods, heavy rain with strong winds and hail (recorded in 2025), and cholera

area.en: Ulanga: Kilombero plain, hills and mining
area.sw: Ulanga: tambarare ya Kilombero, milima na uchimbaji

risk.en: This area has flood plain along the Kilombero, hills where rain washes out roads, and small-scale mining where pits flood and collapse.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare ya mafuriko kando ya Kilombero, milima ambapo mvua husomba barabara, na uchimbaji mdogo ambapo mashimo hujaa maji na kubomoka.

advice.en: For those living, farming and mining here, it helps to build on higher ground, keep stores above flood level and fence or backfill pits. What raises the risk: building on the Kilombero flood plain, digging pits without timbering and working them while rain is falling, and leaving worked-out pits open to fill with water. Know the higher ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the plain floods, keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts, and move stores and animals before the roads wash out. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu za miinuko, kuhifadhi mali juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Kilombero, kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili na kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, na kuacha mashimo yaliyokwisha wazi yajae maji. Fahamu eneo la juu na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia tambarare inapofurika, mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza, na hamisheni akiba na mifugo kabla barabara hazijasombwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
